Don’t see your trade?

Kanosena writes from your own website, so it isn’t limited to these trades. It is made for UK businesses with 1 to 20 staff that want to post regularly on Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn without writing the posts themselves.

Ask for early access and tell us what you do. We’ll tell you honestly whether it’s a good fit.

of posts

Tell us your web address and we’ll draft a week of posts for you to review. Nothing is published until you approve it.
